verses.ar: «وَإِنْ كَانَ قُرْبَانُهُ ذَبِيحَةَ سَلَامَةٍ، فَإِنْ قَرَّبَ مِنَ ٱلْبَقَرِ ذَكَرًا أَوْ أُنْثَى، فَصَحِيحًا يُقَرِّبُهُ أَمَامَ ٱلرَّبِّ.
verses.kjv: And if his oblation [be] a sacrifice of peace offering, if he offer [it] of the herd; whether [it be] a male or female, he shall offer it without blemish before the LORD.
verses.web: “‘If his offering is a sacrifice of peace offerings, if he offers it from the herd, whether male or female, he shall offer it without defect before Yahweh.
verses.he: וְאִם־זֶ֥בַח שְׁלָמִ֖ים קָרְבָּנֹ֑ו אִ֤ם מִן־הַבָּקָר֙ ה֣וּא מַקְרִ֔יב אִם־זָכָר֙ אִם־נְקֵבָ֔ה תָּמִ֥ים יַקְרִיבֶ֖נּוּ לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

verses.ar: يَضَعُ يَدَهُ عَلَى رَأْسِ قُرْبَانِهِ وَيَذْبَحُهُ لَدَى بَابِ خَيْمَةِ ٱلِٱجْتِمَاعِ، وَيَرُشُّ بَنُو هَارُونَ ٱلْكَهَنَةُ ٱلدَّمَ عَلَى ٱلْمَذْبَحِ مُسْتَدِيرًا.
verses.kjv: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of his offering, and kill it [at] the door of the tabernacle of the congregation: and Aaron’s sons the priests shall sprinkle the blood upon the altar round about.
verses.web: He shall lay his hand on the head of his offering, and kill it at the door of the Tent of Meeting. Aaron’s sons, the priests, shall sprinkle the blood around on the altar.
verses.he: וְסָמַ֤ךְ יָדֹו֙ עַל־רֹ֣אשׁ קָרְבָּנֹ֔ו וּשְׁחָטֹ֕ו פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֣הֶל מֹועֵ֑ד וְזָרְק֡וּ בְּנֵי֩ אַהֲרֹ֨ן הַכֹּהֲנִ֧ים אֶת־הַדָּ֛ם עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ סָבִֽיב׃

verses.ar: وَيُقَرِّبُ مِنْ ذَبِيحَةِ ٱلسَّلَامَةِ وَقُودًا لِلرَّبِّ: ٱلشَّحْمَ ٱلَّذِي يُغَشِّي ٱلْأَحْشَاءَ، وَسَائِرَ ٱلشَّحْمِ ٱلَّذِي عَلَى ٱلْأَحْشَاءِ،
verses.kjv: And he shall offer of the sacrifice of the peace offering an offering made by fire unto the LORD; the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that [is] upon the inwards,
verses.web: He shall offer of the sacrifice of peace offerings an offering made by fire to Yahweh. The fat that covers the innards, and all the fat that is on the innards,
verses.he: וְהִקְרִיב֙ מִזֶּ֣בַח הַשְּׁלָמִ֔ים אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַיהוָ֑ה אֶת־הַחֵ֙לֶב֙ הַֽמְכַסֶּ֣ה אֶת־הַקֶּ֔רֶב וְאֵת֙ כָּל־הַחֵ֔לֶב אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־הַקֶּֽרֶב׃

verses.ar: وَٱلْكُلْيَتَيْنِ، وَٱلشَّحْمَ ٱلَّذِي عَلَيْهِمَا ٱلَّذِي عَلَى ٱلْخَاصِرَتَيْنِ، وَزِيَادَةَ ٱلْكَبِدِ مَعَ ٱلْكُلْيَتَيْنِ يَنْزِعُهَا.
verses.kjv: And the two kidneys, and the fat that [is] on them, which [is] by the flanks, and the caul above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away.
verses.web: and the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the loins, and the cover on the liver, with the kidneys, he shall take away.
verses.he: וְאֵת֙ שְׁתֵּ֣י הַכְּלָיֹ֔ת וְאֶת־הַחֵ֙לֶב֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עֲלֵהֶ֔ן אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־הַכְּסָלִ֑ים וְאֶת־הַיֹּתֶ֙רֶת֙ עַל־הַכָּבֵ֔ד עַל־הַכְּלָיֹ֖ות יְסִירֶֽנָּה׃

verses.ar: وَيُوقِدُهَا بَنُو هَارُونَ عَلَى ٱلْمَذْبَحِ عَلَى ٱلْمُحْرَقَةِ ٱلَّتِي فَوْقَ ٱلْحَطَبِ ٱلَّذِي عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ، وَقُودَ رَائِحَةِ سَرُورٍ لِلرَّبِّ.
verses.kjv: And Aaron’s sons shall burn it on the altar upon the burnt sacrifice, which [is] upon the wood that [is] on the fire: [it is] an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.
verses.web: Aaron’s sons shall burn it on the altar on the burnt offering, which is on the wood that is on the fire: it is an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.
verses.he: וְהִקְטִ֨ירוּ אֹתֹ֤ו בְנֵֽי־אַהֲרֹן֙ הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חָה עַל־הָ֣עֹלָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר עַל־הָעֵצִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל־הָאֵ֑שׁ אִשֵּׁ֛ה רֵ֥יחַ נִיחֹ֖חַ לַֽיהוָֽה׃ פ

verses.ar: «وَإِنْ كَانَ قُرْبَانُهُ مِنَ ٱلْغَنَمِ ذَبِيحَةَ سَلَامَةٍ لِلرَّبِّ ذَكَرًا أَوْ أُنْثَى، فَصَحِيحًا يُقَرِّبُهُ.
verses.kjv: ¶ And if his offering for a sacrifice of peace offering unto the LORD [be] of the flock; male or female, he shall offer it without blemish.
verses.web: “‘If his offering for a sacrifice of peace offerings to Yahweh is from the flock, either male or female, he shall offer it without defect.
verses.he: וְאִם־מִן־הַצֹּ֧אן קָרְבָּנֹ֛ו לְזֶ֥בַח שְׁלָמִ֖ים לַיהוָ֑ה זָכָר֙ אֹ֣ו נְקֵבָ֔ה תָּמִ֖ים יַקְרִיבֶֽנּוּ׃

verses.ar: إِنْ قَرَّبَ قُرْبَانَهُ مِنَ ٱلضَّأْنِ يُقَدِّمُهُ أَمَامَ ٱلرَّبِّ.
verses.kjv: If he offer a lamb for his offering, then shall he offer it before the LORD.
verses.web: If he offers a lamb for his offering, then he shall offer it before Yahweh;
verses.he: אִם־כֶּ֥שֶׂב הֽוּא־מַקְרִ֖יב אֶת־קָרְבָּנֹ֑ו וְהִקְרִ֥יב אֹתֹ֖ו לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

verses.ar: يَضَعُ يَدَهُ عَلَى رَأْسِ قُرْبَانِهِ وَيَذْبَحُهُ قُدَّامَ خَيْمَةِ ٱلِٱجْتِمَاعِ. وَيَرُشُّ بَنُو هَارُونَ دَمَهُ عَلَى ٱلْمَذْبَحِ مُسْتَدِيرًا.
verses.kjv: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of his offering, and kill it before the tabernacle of the congregation: and Aaron’s sons shall sprinkle the blood thereof round about upon the altar.
verses.web: and he shall lay his hand on the head of his offering, and kill it before the Tent of Meeting. Aaron’s sons shall sprinkle its blood around on the altar.
verses.he: וְסָמַ֤ךְ אֶת־יָדֹו֙ עַל־רֹ֣אשׁ קָרְבָּנֹ֔ו וְשָׁחַ֣ט אֹתֹ֔ו לִפְנֵ֖י אֹ֣הֶל מֹועֵ֑ד וְ֠זָרְקוּ בְּנֵ֨י אַהֲרֹ֧ן אֶת־דָּמֹ֛ו עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ סָבִֽיב׃

verses.ar: وَيُقَرِّبُ مِنْ ذَبِيحَةِ ٱلسَّلَامَةِ شَحْمَهَا وَقُودًا لِلرَّبِّ: ٱلْأَلْيَةَ صَحِيحَةً مِنْ عِنْدِ ٱلْعُصْعُصِ يَنْزِعُهَا، وَٱلشَّحْمَ ٱلَّذِي يُغَشِّي ٱلْأَحْشَاءَ، وَسَائِرَ ٱلشَّحْمِ ٱلَّذِي عَلَى ٱلْأَحْشَاءِ،
verses.kjv: And he shall offer of the sacrifice of the peace offering an offering made by fire unto the LORD; the fat thereof, [and] the whole rump, it shall he take off hard by the backbone; and the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that [is] upon the inwards,
verses.web: He shall offer from the sacrifice of peace offerings an offering made by fire to Yahweh; its fat, the entire tail fat, he shall take away close to the backbone; and the fat that covers the entrails, and all the fat that is on the entrails,
verses.he: וְהִקְרִ֨יב מִזֶּ֣בַח הַשְּׁלָמִים֮ אִשֶּׁ֣ה לַיהוָה֒ חֶלְבֹּו֙ הָאַלְיָ֣ה תְמִימָ֔ה לְעֻמַּ֥ת הֶעָצֶ֖ה יְסִירֶ֑נָּה וְאֶת־הַחֵ֙לֶב֙ הַֽמְכַסֶּ֣ה אֶת־הַקֶּ֔רֶב וְאֵת֙ כָּל־הַחֵ֔לֶב אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־הַקֶּֽרֶב׃

verses.ar: وَٱلْكُلْيَتَيْنِ، وَٱلشَّحْمَ ٱلَّذِي عَلَيْهِمَا ٱلَّذِي عَلَى ٱلْخَاصِرَتَيْنِ، وَزِيَادَةَ ٱلْكَبِدِ مَعَ ٱلْكُلْيَتَيْنِ يَنْزِعُهَا.
verses.kjv: And the two kidneys, and the fat that [is] upon them, which [is] by the flanks, and the caul above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away.
verses.web: and the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the loins, and the cover on the liver, with the kidneys, he shall take away.
verses.he: וְאֵת֙ שְׁתֵּ֣י הַכְּלָיֹ֔ת וְאֶת־הַחֵ֙לֶב֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עֲלֵהֶ֔ן אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־הַכְּסָלִ֑ים וְאֶת־הַיֹּתֶ֙רֶת֙ עַל־הַכָּבֵ֔ד עַל־הַכְּלָיֹ֖ת יְסִירֶֽנָּה׃

verses.ar: وَيُوقِدُهَا ٱلْكَاهِنُ عَلَى ٱلْمَذْبَحِ طَعَامَ وَقُودٍ لِلرَّبِّ.
verses.kjv: And the priest shall burn it upon the altar: [it is] the food of the offering made by fire unto the LORD.
verses.web: The priest shall burn it on the altar: it is the food of the offering made by fire to Yahweh.
verses.he: וְהִקְטִירֹ֥ו הַכֹּהֵ֖ן הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חָה לֶ֥חֶם אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַיהוָֽה׃ פ

verses.ar: «وَإِنْ كَانَ قُرْبَانُهُ مِنَ ٱلْمَعْزِ يُقَدِّمُهُ أَمَامَ ٱلرَّبِّ.
verses.kjv: ¶ And if his offering [be] a goat, then he shall offer it before the LORD.
verses.web: “‘If his offering is a goat, then he shall offer it before Yahweh.
verses.he: וְאִ֥ם עֵ֖ז קָרְבָּנֹ֑ו וְהִקְרִיבֹ֖ו לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

verses.ar: يَضَعُ يَدَهُ عَلَى رَأْسِهِ وَيَذْبَحُهُ قُدَّامَ خَيْمَةِ ٱلِٱجْتِمَاعِ، وَيَرُشُّ بَنُو هَارُونَ دَمَهُ عَلَى ٱلْمَذْبَحِ مُسْتَدِيرًا.
verses.kjv: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of it, and kill it before the tabernacle of the congregation: and the sons of Aaron shall sprinkle the blood thereof upon the altar round about.
verses.web: He shall lay his hand on its head, and kill it before the Tent of Meeting; and the sons of Aaron shall sprinkle its blood around on the altar.
verses.he: וְסָמַ֤ךְ אֶת־יָדֹו֙ עַל־רֹאשֹׁ֔ו וְשָׁחַ֣ט אֹתֹ֔ו לִפְנֵ֖י אֹ֣הֶל מֹועֵ֑ד וְ֠זָרְקוּ בְּנֵ֨י אַהֲרֹ֧ן אֶת־דָּמֹ֛ו עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ סָבִֽיב׃

verses.ar: وَيُقَرِّبُ مِنْهُ قُرْبَانَهُ وَقُودًا لِلرَّبِّ: ٱلشَّحْمَ ٱلَّذِي يُغَشِّي ٱلْأَحْشَاءَ، وَسَائِرَ ٱلشَّحْمِ ٱلَّذِي عَلَى ٱلْأَحْشَاءِ،
verses.kjv: And he shall offer thereof his offering, [even] an offering made by fire unto the LORD; the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that [is] upon the inwards,
verses.web: He shall offer from it as his offering, an offering made by fire to Yahweh; the fat that covers the innards, and all the fat that is on the innards,
verses.he: וְהִקְרִ֤יב מִמֶּ֙נּוּ֙ קָרְבָּנֹ֔ו אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַֽיהוָ֑ה אֶת־הַחֵ֙לֶב֙ הַֽמְכַסֶּ֣ה אֶת־הַקֶּ֔רֶב וְאֵת֙ כָּל־הַחֵ֔לֶב אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־הַקֶּֽרֶב׃

verses.ar: وَٱلْكُلْيَتَيْنِ وَٱلشَّحْمَ ٱلَّذِي عَلَيْهِمَا ٱلَّذِي عَلَى ٱلْخَاصِرَتَيْنِ، وَزِيَادَةَ ٱلْكَبِدِ مَعَ ٱلْكُلْيَتَيْنِ يَنْزِعُهَا.
verses.kjv: And the two kidneys, and the fat that [is] upon them, which [is] by the flanks, and the caul above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away.
verses.web: and the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the loins, and the cover on the liver, with the kidneys, he shall take away.
verses.he: וְאֵת֙ שְׁתֵּ֣י הַכְּלָיֹ֔ת וְאֶת־הַחֵ֙לֶב֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עֲלֵהֶ֔ן אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־הַכְּסָלִ֑ים וְאֶת־הַיֹּתֶ֙רֶת֙ עַל־הַכָּבֵ֔ד עַל־הַכְּלָיֹ֖ת יְסִירֶֽנָּה׃

verses.ar: وَيُوقِدُهُنَّ ٱلْكَاهِنُ عَلَى ٱلْمَذْبَحِ طَعَامَ وَقُودٍ لِرَائِحَةِ سَرُورٍ. كُلُّ ٱلشَّحْمِ لِلرَّبِّ.
verses.kjv: And the priest shall burn them upon the altar: [it is] the food of the offering made by fire for a sweet savour: all the fat [is] the LORD’s.
verses.web: The priest shall burn them on the altar: it is the food of the offering made by fire, for a pleasant aroma; all the fat is Yahweh’s.
verses.he: וְהִקְטִירָ֥ם הַכֹּהֵ֖ן הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חָה לֶ֤חֶם אִשֶּׁה֙ לְרֵ֣יחַ נִיחֹ֔חַ כָּל־חֵ֖לֶב לַיהוָֽה׃

verses.ar: فَرِيضَةً دَهْرِيَّةً فِي أَجْيَالِكُمْ فِي جَمِيعِ مَسَاكِنِكُمْ: لَا تَأْكُلُوا شَيْئًا مِنَ ٱلشَّحْمِ وَلَا مِنَ ٱلدَّمِ».
verses.kjv: [It shall be] a perpetual statute for your generations throughout all your dwellings, that ye eat neither fat nor blood.
verses.web: “‘It shall be a perpetual statute throughout your generations in all your dwellings, that you shall eat neither fat nor blood.’”
verses.he: חֻקַּ֤ת עֹולָם֙ לְדֹרֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם בְּכֹ֖ל מֹֽושְׁבֹתֵיכֶ֑ם כָּל־חֵ֥לֶב וְכָל־דָּ֖ם לֹ֥א תֹאכֵֽלוּ׃ פ
